_about: M1-ART-02 post-import rules for hero characters (game/core/import/characters_post_import.gd, AssetImportRules). Each glTF material slot maps to <asset dir>/materials/<slot>.tres, the table AshaStage applies at runtime. LODs: Godot's auto LODs inside each file plus a separate <hero>_lod1.glb (no authored -lodN chains). Characters have no static collision. Asha is listed under adoption_pending while M1-CHR-03 rebuilds her; docs/kb/tech/asset_import.md says how she adopts these rules.

adoption_pending.res://assets/characters/asha/: M1-CHR-03 is rebuilding Asha; she adopts these rules after it lands (docs/kb/tech/asset_import.md)
